item.title: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
item.description:
Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. It is in enterprise research preview, with no published benchmarks, size or pricing yet.

The post Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy
item.description:
Cmpnd released dspy-wsp, a prototype DSPy optimizer for weight-space programming. A frontier LLM reads a small model’s weights, edits them in a sandbox, and tests each change, with no gradients and about $5 to $10 per run.

The post Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
item.description:
Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. It reaches 84.33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context.

The post Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
item.description:
Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control.

The post Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate
item.description:
Perplexity Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 are open-weight decision models that return probabilities, not text. Version 1.3 adds Locate for span extraction and reports 91.6% mean accuracy on 63 query-classification tasks.

The post Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
item.description:
Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models.

The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Than Gemini 3.8 Flash
item.description:
Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast agentic model with a 1M-token window, 4 thinking levels and $1.50/$7.50 pricing. Google reports a 51 Artificial Analysis score and 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1.

The post Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Than Gemini 3.8 Flash appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec
item.description:
Liquid AI released LiquidCodec, a ~74M-parameter streaming audio codec that powers LFM3-Audio-2B and LFM3-Omni-2B. It runs at 12.5 Hz with 12 codebooks and encodes about 361x faster than real time on a single CPU thread.

The post Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: CopilotKit Releases OpenBot 1.0: An MIT-Licensed, Self-Hostable AI Coworker With Built-In Governance
item.description:
CopilotKit released OpenBot 1.0, an MIT-licensed, self-hostable AI coworker workspace. Companies bring their own agents, models and infrastructure, while every Bot action passes a policy check and lands in an audit trail.
